title: Figure 6: Probability density of distance to nearest ET civilization - numerical example
description: Bell-shaped curve titled 'DISTANCE OF NEAREST ET_CIVILIZATION', with probability density function (1/meters, up to 5.63x10^-20) versus 'ET_Distance from Earth (light years)' (0-5000), peaking near 2000 light years. Captioned 'Figure 6. This is the probability of finding the nearest ExtraTerrestrial Civilization at the distance r from Earth (in light years) if the values assumed in the Drake Equation are those shown in Table 1', noting a mode of 1933 light years. Above are equations (148)-(151) deriving the median and the heading 'Numerical Example of the ET_Distance Distribution'.
